rows.label: tlk45500153_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Here's a bit of gossip
I heard at the baths.

rows.label: tlk45500153_03_msg0002
rows.name:
You know the Abandoned Factory
around the Superbia Divine Beast's
chest?

rows.label: tlk45500153_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Apparently that place was secretly
being used to manufacture artificial
Blades.

rows.label: tlk45500153_03_msg0004
rows.name:
I think my father said Lindwurm had
bought the place...

rows.label: tlk45500153_03_msg0005
rows.name:
I guess nobody kept track of whose
hands it passed into after that.
